title: Release grant milestone 2 when the work is shown
instructions: You decide whether milestone 2 of a developer grant was met. MET if the pinned release notes and repository snapshot show every deliverable the grant lists for milestone 2, NOT_MET if any is missing, HOLD if the evidence is missing or contradictory.

context.label: Grant terms (example)
context.content: Example grant. Three milestones paid from one escrow: milestone 1, 2,000 USDC, design doc; milestone 2, 3,000 USDC, a TypeScript SDK with published docs and tests above 80 percent coverage; milestone 3, 5,000 USDC, a production integration.

context.label: Release notes v0.2.0 (example)
context.content: Example release notes, v0.2.0. TypeScript SDK released. Docs site published. CI coverage report: 86 percent.

question.prompt: Was milestone 2 of the ledger SDK grant met?
